title: Birds X Neil MacCormick
description:
These tees are a collaboration between Birds of North America, and artist Neil MacCormick. Neil has painted full time since 1984 and co-owns Birds of North America with his partner, designer Hayley Gibson. The two have shared a studio since meeting in 2006.

—

In early 2025, I went through Neil’s entire oeuvre and chose a half dozen pieces that I thought would make amazing T-shirts. I ended up unconsciously gravitating towards his paintings from the West Coast of Canada, my place of origin, done between 1993- 2002.

Neil moved out west in 1989, after growing up in Toronto, and found that certain types of things stood out to him. ‘Victoria had a really different feeling to me - in a way I was just trying to identify what exactly that feeling was. Part of it was that the culture was so different, like the trailers and campers that dotted the streets. Part of it was the time capsule feeling of things that had disappeared in Toronto before I left - old storefronts and signs especially. It was like everything I was interested in was still there - as if the era I grew up in was still represented in Victoria.’  

I feel like the images Neil took during this time, when he was still new to the city, captured something elusive, intangible and pure about the West Coast. They somehow succeed at distilling everything important about 80’s and 90’s West Coast Canadian communities to me. I find that this particular selection of his work also captures the beautiful heartache feeling of eternal childhood summers. I hope you can feel it too.

~ Hayley

title: Burt-Back-Rack
description:
Welcome to the Burt-Back-Rack! This is where you will find styles from the ‘back rack’ at Birds HQ for 70% off! 

This notorious rack lives in the deepest recesses of the studio, at the very back of our inventory stash, and is home to all of our oldest styles, some of which have been hanging around for so long that I Say A Little Prayer that they will find forever homes every time I Walk On By. 

We’re pleased to offer 70% off the Burt-Back-Rack styles so you can Make It Easy On Yourself and nab any of these pieces that are saying ‘Reach Out For Me’ in an urgent whisper. Please make them go away!

title: ReNests
description:
Welcome to our ReNesting section! We've received all of these styles as part of our ReNesting program, and everything has been laundered, inspected for damage, repaired, photographed, and listed for resale below so it can find a loving new home!

We do our best to accurately document the condition of each item, but these are pre-loved garments so we may miss the odd thing. Rest assured that you can return anything purchased here for a refund if it doesn't meet your expectations in terms of fit and quality!

PLEASE NOTE: Many pieces fit a size or so smaller than the listed size due to washing, and changes in our sizing over time. You can use our size filter at the top of the page to see what's available in your size.

Since launching the ReNesting Program in March of 2021, we have collected around 1755 used Birds items, and have been able to re-list 95% of these pieces for sale! A portion of each sale is donated to the Toronto Wildlife Centre. To date, we have donated a total of $2976.79 to the TWC! Thanks for considering giving a second life to all of these pre-loved Birdies!
